constraints: The default table for the process is used when aTable is omitted.
The current selection is copied into set and the current record pointer is saved with it; USE SET restores both the selection and current record later.
Sets have no sort order of their own; when a set is used, the default (creation) record order applies.
If a set with the same name already exists, it is cleared/replaced by the new set.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a set from a table's current selection, saving both the selection and current record so USE SET can restore them later.
